title: YouTube Video to Short Clips + Captions
description: Drop in a YouTube URL. This system fetches the transcript, feeds it to AI, and identifies the best clip moments with timestamps, suggested captions, and hashtag sets — ready for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Shorts. No one has to sit through the full video.

title: LinkedIn Scheduled Posts
description: A content calendar built through AI automation. Every day, this system checks what post is pending and publishes it to LinkedIn automatically at a set time. Brand tone, captions, and hashtags handled automatically. No manual posting, no forgetting.

title: Instagram Daily Posts (Reels, Photos, Carousels)
description: Automatically posts Reels, photos, and carousels to Instagram every day from a content calendar. Images, captions, and hashtags are prepared and queued — the system handles the posting on schedule without any manual action.
